requirements.text: You might be a great fit if you’re a strong, versatile software engineer who enjoys working across the stack and solving whatever technical problems matter most. You’re comfortable working across frontend and backend—or bring particularly deep expertise in frontend engineering—and have strong software engineering fundamentals. You’re excited about Agentic AI / LLM applications, even if you haven’t worked directly with AI before.
* 4+ years building high-quality software, ideally in excellent engineering cultures
* Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to reason about architecture, abstractions, performance, reliability, and complexity—not just specific frameworks or technologies
* Comfortable working across TypeScript, GraphQL, MongoDB, and Vue; experience with our exact stack is helpful but not required

* Experience helping engineering teams scale—not only by writing great code, but by creating abstractions, systems, tools, and processes that establish clear swim lanes and reduce complexity for other engineers
* Interested in Agentic AI, LLM applications, and emerging technologies. Experience with MCP or building AI agents is a plus, but not required
* Coding comes naturally to you, you do it for fun, and you excel at it professionally
* You set a high bar for craft and execution, and you’re known as a creative, trusted, and resourceful teammate who elevates those around you
* High-ownership—you take projects, outcomes, and customer unlocks from an ambiguous starting point through to a clean finish
* Thrive in fast-paced environments, biasing toward action rather than waiting for someone else to tell you what to do or how to solve a problem
* Customer-focused—you care about customers’ challenges and ambitions and are energized by building technology that empowers people
* Enjoy mentoring and accelerating people around you who are hungry to learn, regardless of their level of experience
* Eager to join our mission of bringing Frontier Intelligence to the industries and institutions that matter most to human welfare—e.g., healthcare, government, and financial infrastructure
* A doer of things—technical or otherwise—that people have told you were impossible or foolish
